mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.post_type AS postType, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, p.write_date AS `date`, u.nickname AS nickname, p.like_num AS `likeCount`, p.`view` AS `viewCount`, COALESCE(COUNT(c.comment_id), 0) AS `commentCount`, (p.delete_check = 1) AS deleted FROM lala.post p JOIN lala.user u ON u.user_id = p.writer_id LEFT JOIN lala.comment c ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE p.writer_id = #{userId} OR c.writer_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.post_id, p.post_type, p.title, p.content, p.write_date, u.nickname, p.like_num, p.`view`, p.delete_check ORDER BY p.write_date DESC LIMIT 3
